name: Iron Tower
look: a grey armoured golem with a small black-visored helmet of orange dots, two dark back pillars tipped with glowing orange cones and huge forearms ending in glowing orange fists
entry: A Pokémon resembling Regirock, recorded in an old journal about a canyon that crackled with lightning. The pillars on its back store the charge for its huge fists, and one blow is said to shatter a boulder into glowing sand.
how: Wild: very rare in badlands and on mountain peaks.
